sources.title: Mitsubishi Motors North America — Montero features and specifications (mechanical), 2004 model year

en.title: 20th Anniversary
en.summary: A commemorative North American trim listed alongside the two regular ones on the factory specification sheet, mechanically identical to them and distinguished by wheels and interior appointments.

es.title: 20th Anniversary
es.summary: Un acabado conmemorativo norteamericano que aparece junto a los dos regulares en la hoja de especificaciones de fábrica, mecánicamente idéntico a ellos y diferenciado por los aros y por los detalles interiores.
